annotation_note: tuned_on_val thresholds and evaluation share validation; optimistic annotation estimates
fit_note: scalers, vocabulary, and model parameters fitted on train only
explanations: Exact text-column contributions of the combined model; intercept and style contributions must also be considered.
confusion_note: co-occurring missed/extra labels; missing tags may be annotation omissions
review_method: Assistant qualitative inspection of each sampled full lyric and observed/predicted tags; no independent audio verification of semantic judgments.
